title: NNSA's seventy-two object-version cells now carry 864 bounded dimension classifications
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy and National Nuclear Security Administration
summary: Every cell is classified across presence, absence, scope, cost, schedule, capacity, qualification, output, completion, capability, implementation, and independent closure. Denominator: Eighteen objects, four source versions, seventy-two cells, twelve dimensions, and 864 classifications.
